verdict: Ready to merge: the guard at StockOperationActionResource.save closes the only path where a request-body UUID drives findStockOperations, it returns 400 on REST 3.0, and its tests go red when the guard is removed.
what_i_swept: Diff stat checked: 3 files, +131/-1, and identical for master...HEAD and master HEAD, so no drift. Read the ticket O3-6201 and the PR body. Read the full resource, ResourceBase, the StockOperationAction DTO and the DAO filter (StockManagementDao.java:719 drops the uuid condition when it is blank, which confirms the root cause). In webservices.rest 3.0.0, DelegatingCrudResource.create calls convert, then save, so 'uuid' from the body reaches the delegate; BaseRestController.handleException maps @ResponseStatus, so IllegalRequestException gives 400 and ObjectNotFoundException gives 404, while the old Spring RestClientException has no annotation and gave 500. Outward trace: grepped every findStockOperations / getData().get(0) caller. StockOperationResource and StockOperationBatchNumbersResource getByUniqueId take the URL path id, which cannot be blank. saveStockOperationBatchNumbers already guards a blank uuid (StockManagementServiceImpl.java:3321). sendStockOperationNotification gets its uuid from a saved DTO (StockManagementServiceImpl.java:1977), not from user input. No other body-uuid search path exists. Frontend (esm-stock-management-app main, 9e9cd98 including #697): executeStockOperationAction errors go through extractErrorMessagesFromResponse in stock-operations.modal.tsx:92 and do not depend on the status code, so the 500-to-404 change does not affect them. Approach: the alternatives were frontend-only (#697 alone leaves the API acting on the wrong operation for any other client), a DAO change (that would break list search, which relies on a blank uuid meaning no filter), and a direct by-uuid lookup (that would bypass the record-privilege filtering findStockOperations applies). The resource-level guard is the proportionate fix. pom hunk: openmrs-test (test scope, version managed in the root pom.xml:65-71) mirrors api/pom.xml:31-36. omod had no tests on master, so the hunk is needed for the new test. commons-lang StringUtils matches the other omod resources. Tests: StockOperationActionResourceTest 4/4 pass at head. Mutation control: disabling the guard and reverting ObjectNotFoundException to RestClientException gave 1 failure and 2 errors, in exactly the blank-uuid, 400 and 404 tests. Restored with git checkout; working copy clean.
could_not_verify: Behaviour end to end against a running OpenMRS server with REST 3.x. No server was available, so it needs access I don't have. The controller-level 400 mapping was checked by reading BaseRestController and by the PR's handleException test, not over HTTP.
notes: shouldSubmitOnlyTheRequestedOperationWhenAnotherOperationIsNewer would also pass on base, because the mock only ever returns the older DTO. It documents correct targeting rather than guarding against this regression; the PR body presents it that way, so I did not file it. A missing 'name' still causes an NPE (500) in the switch. That is pre-existing and outside this ticket, so I did not file it.
